Esika, God of the Tree: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."
Sol Ring: "The Eye of Harmony. Exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole. Time Lord engineering."  - The Eleventh Doctor
Sonic Screwdriver: The Doctor's technologically advanced tool helps them out in most situations.
Akroma's Memorial: "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."  - Memorial inscription
Propaganda: "You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."  - Volrath, to Karn
Elven Chorus: Elvish singing was not a thing to miss, in June under the stars.
Everybody Lives!: "Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!"  - The Ninth Doctor
Arid Mesa: "This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan. How I have outgrown her."  - Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
Cascading Cataracts: "The power that flows here cannot be denied. But where is the source?"  - Nissa Revane
Crystal Quarry: "How tragic that greed eclipses beauty."  - Seton, centaur druid
Flooded Strand: Where dragons once slept, their bones now rest.
Gaea's Cradle: "Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall."  - Gamelen, Citanul elder
Godless Shrine: Sin is debt, and absolution is paid in tithes of gold and blood.
Indatha Triome: "These lowlands were formed thousands of years ago by the behemoth Indath - its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea."  - Tales of the Ozolith
Jetmir's Garden: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.
Ketria Triome: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.
Mana Confluence: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.
Marsh Flats: "We remember all the world has endured, everything it has gone through to bring us to today. We are proud of Tarkir."  - Betor
Misty Rainforest:
In the mist, turbulent enough to deafen.
Beneath the boughs, serene enough to soothe.
Polluted Delta: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.
Raffine's Tower: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.
Raugrin Triome: Raugrin meets the sea with jaws wide, its coast spiked with teeth of crystal and granite.
Reflecting Pool: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?
Sacred Foundry: "You will not be trained here. You will be forged."  - Commander Yaszen
Scalding Tarn: "I came here often to meditate on Ojutai's teachings. Now, I must also consider his failings."  - Narset
Spara's Headquarters: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.
Steam Vents: "A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine."  - Zija, Simic mutationist
Watery Grave: "I fear that as we scurry after phantoms, the Dimir pull nine puppet strings."  - Ral Zarek
Windswept Heath: An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.
Zagoth Triome: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.
